== Overview ==

'''NATTraversalReportInternalProtocol''' is one of the [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols#Internal protocols|internal protocols]], used by the game servers to communicate with each other rather than by any game client. Its protocol ID is not known, though its method IDs are.

All three of its methods share their names with the reporting methods of [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/NATTraversalProtocol|NATTraversalProtocol]], and take nearly identical parameters. This, plus the protocols name, suggests this is an internal counterpart of [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/NATTraversalProtocol|NATTraversalProtocol]], letting servers report a users NAT properties to each other, though it is not known how these results would be identified to a specific user?

=== ReportNATTraversalResult ===

Presumed to be the internal counterpart of [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/NATTraversalProtocol#ReportNATTraversalResult|NATTraversalProtocol#ReportNATTraversalResult]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || Unknown || Likely <code>cid</code>
|-
| UInt32 || Unknown || Likely <code>rtt</code>
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.
